Atlantis NDT LMS 2027 — Enterprise NDT Corporate Training Platform

Atlantis NDT LMS delivers enterprise-grade NDT corporate training infrastructure for inspection contractors, EPC operators, and asset owners running in-house NDT training programs across multiple regions, methods, and cert schemes. Designed by ASNT NDT Level III practitioners, not generic LMS vendors — knows the difference between SNT-TC-1A 2024 Written Practice + CP-189-2020 + ISO 9712:2021 + NAS 410 + EN 4179 + PCN + ACCP cert pathways.

Role-Based Learning Paths per Method + Level + Vertical

Pre-built learning paths: Level I (assist + gather + follow procedure) → Level II (independent setup + acquisition + interpretation) → Level III (procedure authoring + program ownership + technique development). Per-method paths: UT, RT, MT, PT, ET, VT, PAUT, TOFD, IRT, AE, LT, LRUT, ECA. Per-vertical paths: refining (API 510/570/571/579/581/653 stack), marine (IACS Rec-20 + classification society), aerospace (NAS 410 / EN 4179), power-gen (ASME XI nuclear + ASME PCC-3), LNG, mining, hydrogen, CCS.

ISO 17024 Personnel Cert Body Alignment

Built-in alignment with ISO 17024:2012 for cert-body customers. Schemes module — define + version cert schemes with eligibility + experience + exam + recert criteria. Application + assessment workflow per ISO 17024 §9. Examination record retention. Decision-rule library for borderline scores. Surveillance + recertification automation. Suspension + withdrawal records. Auto-generated annual ISO 17024 surveillance audit pack.

Content Authoring — SCORM 1.2/2004 + xAPI + Cmi5 + Native

Author once, deploy everywhere. SCORM 1.2 + SCORM 2004 + xAPI (Tin Can) + Cmi5 + native HTML5 content packs supported. Atlantis NDT seed content library — 200+ hours of NDT-specific content covering ASNT pathway + ISO 9712 pathway + API ICP pathway. Custom-content authoring via in-platform authoring tool (no separate Articulate / Captivate licence required). Translated into 12 languages — English, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, German, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Vietnamese, Tagalog.

Multi-Site + Multi-Region + Multi-Tenant Rollout

Designed for global inspection contractors with 5-50+ sites. Tenant isolation per business unit, region, or cert-body sub-brand. Single-tenant on-prem deployment for highly regulated customers (defense, nuclear). SaaS multi-tenant for mid-scale customers. Hybrid for compliance-sensitive multi-region. SSO via SAML 2.0 + OIDC + Azure AD + Okta + Ping. Active Directory sync for inspector roster.

Integrations — ERP + Cert Tracking + Reporting + DT

Native integration with Atlantis NDT ERP (inspector roster + cert tracking + work order + dispatch), Atlantis Reporting Software (inspector cert verification at job dispatch), Atlantis Digital Twin platform (simulator-driven training on actual customer assets). REST API + webhook for SAP SuccessFactors, Workday Learning, Cornerstone OnDemand, SumTotal, Saba, Docebo migration.

Free Consultation + Implementation Roadmap

Free 30-min consultation scopes: cohort size + cert-scheme mix + content-authoring scope + integration surface + multi-region rollout phasing + data migration. Implementation 8-20 weeks for enterprise multi-site rollout, 4 weeks for SMB single-site. Affordable, accessible, fully customizable. ASNT NDT Level III-led implementation.
